title: elymus multiflorus var. longisetus
intro: Elymus multiflorus var. longisetus, commonly known as Wild Bunchgrass or Wild Blue-grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Elymus multiflorus var. longisetus include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate respiratory problems, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
